review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Implement the final-output coordinate correction and tests after this review commit
review.notes: Addresses independent review P2 of H62b26796: final PNG device anchors shifted -64px after screenshot/crop, and the nominal top58% marker did not enclose the complete English decision card. Preserve that failure and the earlier framing guard. Add separate source-coordinate critical bounds x40,y190,w1240,h1730 enclosing HQ header through the entire needs-input card including explanation/time in both verified1320x2868 captures. Remove post-render cropping, enforce exact final PNG dimensions and pixel-anchor agreement, then validate critical bounds. These tests do not replace image inspection, real ASC device preview or Apple review.

cases.description: Final PNG and recorded device geometry use one origin
cases.setup: Small generated RGB PNG with known #101114 device-top pixels and matching canvas/DOM rectangles.
cases.action: Decode the PNG and compare the top edge at each device midpoint with the recorded auxiliary rectangle.
cases.expected: Matching exact canvas dimensions and pixel anchors pass; a -64px anchor translation fails.
surfaces: App Store renderer final RGB PNG / safe-area verification

cases.description: Reject incomplete or incompatible final output
cases.setup: Known valid synthetic RGB PNG, truncated/unsupported PNG inputs and a canvas dimension mismatch.
cases.action: Check final PNG validation independently with each malformed or mismatched input.
cases.expected: Invalid PNG format, non-RGB output, missing device anchor or dimension mismatch fail explicitly.
surfaces: App Store renderer final RGB PNG / safe-area verification

cases.description: Protect the entire HQ and decision story rather than a screen percentage
cases.setup: Both production layouts and source bounds x40,y190,width1240,height1730 from the verified1320x2868 EN/CN HQ captures.
cases.action: Transform those explicit source bounds into canvas coordinates, then validate all safe-area edges.
cases.expected: The full region including English decision explanation and timestamp fits both official safe areas. Bounds outside the source or safe region are rejected.
surfaces: App Store renderer final RGB PNG / safe-area verification

cases.description: The final-output verifier detects the original crop regression
cases.setup: Synthetic RGB canvas with expected device tops safely below64 and an otherwise valid matching geometry.
cases.action: First validate matching anchors; then shift painted edges up64 while retaining the same dimensions and recorded geometry.
cases.expected: The matching version passes and the shifted version fails. Pixel probing is independent of the DOM-only geometry assertions.
surfaces: App Store renderer final RGB PNG / safe-area verification
